topic: Aldosterone's kidney role — blood pressure and electrolytes
caption: Did you know aldosterone regulates your blood pressure? 🌟 It's a hormone that helps your kidneys control electrolyte balance. 💡 Here are the key facts: aldosterone helps the kidneys retain sodium and water, increasing blood volume and pressure. 📈 It also helps remove excess potassium. 🚽 Save this so you don't lose it.
